---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::hgt-site=0.4.0

process HGTSITE_CALL {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/hgt-site:0.4.0--pyhdfd78af_0' :
        'quay.io/biocontainers/hgt-site:0.4.0--pyhdfd78af_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(alignment), path(index)
    tuple val(meta2), path(classifications)
    val host_taxid
    val save_bed
    val save_vcf
    val save_multiqc

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.tsv")                            , emit: tsv
    tuple val(meta), path("*.bed")            , optional:true , emit: bed
    tuple val(meta), path("*.vcf.gz")         , optional:true , emit: vcf
    tuple val(meta), path("*.vcf.gz.tbi")     , optional:true , emit: tbi
    tuple val(meta), path("*_mqc.json")       , optional:true , emit: multiqc
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('hgtsite'), eval('hgt-site --version | sed "s/^hgt-site //"'), topic: versions, emit: versions_hgtsite

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def bed_option = save_bed ? "--bed ${prefix}.bed" : ""
    def vcf_option = save_vcf ? "--vcf ${prefix}.vcf.gz" : ""
    def multiqc_option = save_multiqc ? "--multiqc ${prefix}_mqc.json" : ""
    """
    hgt-site call \\
        --bam ${alignment} \\
        --classifications ${classifications} \\
        --host-taxid ${host_taxid} \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        --sample-name ${prefix} \\
        ${bed_option} \\
        ${vcf_option} \\
        ${multiqc_option} \\
        -o ${prefix}.tsv \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    // One representative line per file rather than an empty one, so the stub
    // resembles the real output. gzip -n keeps the timestamp out, which would
    // otherwise change the checksum on every run.
    def bed_stub = save_bed ? "printf 'chr1\\t1000\\t1200\\ttaxid_562\\t12\\t.\\n' > ${prefix}.bed" : ""
    def vcf_stub = save_vcf ? "printf '##fileformat=VCFv4.2\\n#CHROM\\tPOS\\tID\\tREF\\tALT\\tQUAL\\tFILTER\\tINFO\\n' | gzip -n > ${prefix}.vcf.gz" : ""
    def multiqc_stub = save_multiqc ? "echo '{\"id\": \"hgt_site\"}' > ${prefix}_mqc.json" : ""
    """
    printf 'chrom\\tstart\\tend\\n' > ${prefix}.tsv
    ${bed_stub}
    ${vcf_stub}
    ${multiqc_stub}
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/hgtsite/call"
description: "Call candidate horizontal gene transfer sites from a host alignment\
  \ and per-read taxonomic classifications"
keywords:
- "horizontal gene transfer"
- "integration site"
- "metagenomics"
- "contamination"
- "structural variant"
tools:
- hgtsite:
    description: "Calls candidate horizontal gene transfer and integration sites from\
      \ paired-end reads aligned to a host genome and per-read taxonomic classifications\
      \ of the reads that did not align, testing each candidate against the number\
      \ of chimeric pairs chance alone would place there."
    homepage: "https://github.com/iraajgangavaram/hgt-site"
    documentation: "https://iraajgangavaram.github.io/hgt-site/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/iraajgangavaram/hgt-site"
    doi: "10.5281/zenodo.23842712"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:hgt-site"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information, e.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - alignment:
      type: "file"
      description: "Paired-end reads aligned to the host genome, keeping the pairs\
        \ where one mate did not align"
      pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - index:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index for the alignment. Optional, but without it the exact junctions\
        \ from split reads are not searched for"
      pattern: "*.{bai,crai}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3327"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing information about the classifications, e.g.\
        \ `[ id:'sample1' ]`\n"
  - classifications:
      type: "file"
      description: "Per-read taxonomic calls for the unmapped reads, from Kraken2,\
        \ KrakenUniq, Kaiju, Centrifuge, DIAMOND or BLAST, or a two-column file of\
        \ read name and taxid"
      pattern: "*.{txt,tsv,gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/data_2526"
- host_taxid:
    type: "integer"
    description: "NCBI taxid of the host, for example 9606 for human"
- save_bed:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Write the sites that passed every filter as a BED file"
- save_vcf:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Write every candidate site as a block compressed, tabix indexed\
      \ VCF"
- save_multiqc:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Write a summary table for MultiQC"
output:
  tsv:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\n"
    - '*.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Every candidate site, with the reason each one failed in the\
          \ filter column"
        pattern: "*.tsv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  bed:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\n"
    - '*.bed':
        type: "file"
        description: "The sites that passed every filter, written when save_bed is\
          \ true"
        pattern: "*.bed"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
  vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\n"
    - '*.vcf.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Every candidate site as a VCF insertion record, written when\
          \ save_vcf is true"
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  tbi:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\n"
    - '*.vcf.gz.tbi':
        type: "file"
        description: "Tabix index for the VCF, written when save_vcf is true"
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz.tbi"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3616"
  multiqc:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\n"
    - '*_mqc.json':
        type: "file"
        description: "Summary table for MultiQC, written when save_multiqc is true"
        pattern: "*_mqc.json"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3464"
  versions_hgtsite:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - hgtsite:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - hgt-site --version | sed "s/^hgt-site //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - hgtsite:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - hgt-site --version | sed "s/^hgt-site //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@iraajgangavaram"
maintainers:
- "@iraajgangavaram"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
